title: Review semantic implementation artifacts
summary: A developer can run a local tool to understand a semantic review artifact and inspect each implementation stage.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The tool loads the manifest and every indexed requirement and stage document without relying on directory discovery.
The tool presents requirements, stage order, dependencies, rationale, decisions, assumptions, alternatives, failed attempts, risks, validation evidence, and open questions.
The tool presents the Git diff associated with each finalized stage.
Missing, malformed, or inconsistent artifact data is surfaced as an explicit error.
The proof of concept runs locally without external services.
After every implementation stage, the tool can process the semantic artifacts produced for this proof of concept.
